u1.q: — ____ do you study for a test? — I study by working with a group.
u1.explain: 问方式用 How，答语用 by + doing 表示方式。

u1.q: He was ____ tired ____ he fell asleep at once.
u1.explain: so + 形容词 + that + 从句，表示如此……以至于……。

u1.q: I find it helpful ____ English songs.
u1.explain: find it + adj. + to do sth，it 作形式宾语，真正宾语是不定式。

u1.q: She speaks English ____ that everyone can understand her.
u1.explain: 修饰动词 speaks 要用副词 clearly，构成 so...that 结构。

u1.q: Which word means 'to say words in the correct way'?
u1.explain: pronounce 意为发音；promise 承诺，produce 生产，protect 保护。

u1.q: The problem is ____ hard for me to work out.
u1.explain: too + adj. + for sb + to do sth，太……而不能……。

u1.q: Our teacher tells us not to be afraid of ____ mistakes.
u1.explain: be afraid of 后接动名词，of 是介词。

u1.q: 'Memorize' has almost the same meaning as ____.
u1.explain: memorize 记忆、背诵，等于 learn by heart。

u1.q: Reading aloud every morning can improve your ____.
u1.explain: 朗读能改善发音 pronunciation。

u1.q: ____ word cards is a good way to remember new words.
u1.explain: 动名词短语作主语，Making word cards。

u1.q: He didn't do well in the exam ____ he didn't study hard.
u1.explain: 后面是原因，用 because 引导原因状语从句。

u1.q: The teacher speaks so fast that I can't ____ her.
u1.explain: follow 在这里意为听懂、跟上（讲话内容）。

u1.q: Which phrases describe ways of learning?
options: by asking the teacher for help
u1.explain: 整天看电视不是学习方式，其余都是有效的学习方法。

u1.q: Which sentences are grammatically correct?
options: I learn English by reading aloud.
I find it hard to learn grammar.
The box is too heavy for me to carry.
He is so young that can't go to school.
u1.explain: D 项 that 从句缺主语，应为 that he can't go to school。

u1.q: Which words are about language learning?
u1.explain: furniture 家具与语言学习无关。

u1.q: Which are correct 'so...that' sentences?
options: It was so cold that we stayed at home.
She was so tired that she went to bed early.
He is so a good student that everyone likes him.
The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
u1.explain: C 应为 such a good student 或 so good a student。

u1.q: 'Too...to' 结构在意义上相当于否定，译为'太……而不能……'。
u1.explain: too...to 含否定意义。

u1.q: 在 'find it + adj. + to do sth' 中，it 是真正的宾语。
u1.explain: it 是形式宾语，后面的不定式才是真正的宾语。

u1.q: Making mistakes is a normal part of learning a language.
u1.explain: 犯错是语言学习的正常过程。

u1.q: 'Look up a word' means to search for it in a dictionary.
u1.explain: look up 意为查阅（词典）。

u1.q: 'Give up' means to keep on doing something.
u1.explain: give up 意为放弃，与坚持相反。

u1.q: Connecting new words with pictures can help you remember them.
u1.explain: 词图联想是有效的记忆策略。

u1.q: 在 so...that 结构中，that 引导的是结果状语从句。
u1.explain: that 后为结果状语从句。

u1.q: The noun form of the verb 'pronounce' is ____.
u1.explain: pronounce 的名词形式为 pronunciation，注意拼写变化。

u1.q: '犯错误' in English is 'make ____' (plural).
u1.explain: make mistakes 犯错误。

u1.q: Complete: It is important ____ (practice) speaking every day.
u1.explain: It is + adj. + to do sth 结构。

u1.q: '耐心'（名词）in English is ____.
u1.explain: patience 是名词，形容词为 patient。

u1.q: '与他人合作' — 'work ____ others'.
u1.explain: work with sb 与某人合作。

u1.q: The past tense of 'read' is spelled ____ (the same spelling).
u1.explain: read 的过去式拼写不变，读音变为 /red/。

u1.q: '逐渐地' in English is ____ (an adverb ending in -ly).
u1.explain: gradual 的副词形式 gradually。

u2.q: I believe ____ he is telling the truth.
u2.explain: 陈述内容用 that 引导宾语从句。

u2.q: Can you tell me ____ the Spring Festival is celebrated in your hometown?
u2.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序，问方式用 how。

u2.q: I'm not sure ____ she likes mooncakes or not.
u2.explain: 与 or not 连用只能用 whether。

u2.q: He asked me ____ I had finished my homework.
u2.explain: 一般疑问句变宾语从句用 if/whether。

u2.q: She told me that she ____ to Beijing the next week.
u2.explain: 主句过去时，从句用过去将来时 would go。

u2.q: The Water Festival is an important festival in ____.
u2.explain: 泼水节是泰国等地的重要节日。

u2.q: Do you know ____?
u2.explain: 宾语从句要用陈述语序，主语 he 后用 lives。

u2.q: People eat ____ during the Dragon Boat Festival.
u2.explain: 端午节吃粽子 zongzi。

u2.q: The colour ____ stands for good luck in China.
u2.explain: 红色在中国象征吉祥好运。

u2.q: I think that the story ____ interesting.
u2.explain: 从句主语 the story 是单数，用 is。

u2.q: Halloween is on the ____ of October.
u2.explain: 万圣节前夜是 10 月 31 日。

u2.q: The teacher said that the earth ____ around the sun.
u2.explain: 客观真理在宾语从句中仍用一般现在时。

u2.q: Which words can introduce object clauses?
u2.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，不引导宾语从句。

u2.q: Which are traditional festival foods?
u2.explain: umbrella 雨伞不是食物。

u2.q: Which sentences have the correct word order?
options: I don't know where he is.
Could you tell me what time it is?
Do you know where is the bank?
I wonder if she will come.
u2.explain: C 项应为 where the bank is。

u2.q: Which are common Spring Festival activities?
u2.explain: 吃火鸡是感恩节和圣诞节的习俗。

u2.q: 'Whether' 和 'if' 在宾语从句中都可以表示'是否'。
u2.explain: 两者常可互换表示是否。

u2.q: 'Whether or not' 可以连用，但 'if or not' 不可以。
u2.explain: or not 紧跟时只能用 whether。

u2.q: The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the 15th day of the eighth lunar month.
u2.explain: 中秋节为农历八月十五。

u2.q: Thanksgiving Day is a traditional Chinese festival.
u2.explain: 感恩节是美国等西方国家的节日。

u2.q: 当主句是过去时，宾语从句通常要用过去的某种时态。
u2.explain: 主过从过是时态一致原则。

u2.q: People eat yuanxiao (tangyuan) at the Lantern Festival.
u2.explain: 元宵节吃元宵/汤圆。

u2.q: 宾语从句应该使用疑问语序。
u2.explain: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序。

u2.q: According to the legend, Chang'e flew to the ____.
u2.explain: 嫦娥奔月，moon 意为月亮。

u2.q: Complete: I wonder ____ (是否) it will rain tomorrow.
u2.explain: whether 或 if 均可表是否，此处填 whether。

u2.q: '圣诞节' in English is ____.
u2.explain: Christmas 圣诞节，首字母大写。

u2.q: The noun form of the verb 'celebrate' is ____.
u2.explain: celebrate 的名词形式为 celebration。

u2.q: '团聚；聚在一起' — 'get ____'.
u2.explain: get together 相聚、团聚。

u2.q: Fill in the blank: He said he ____ (will) come the next day.
u2.explain: 主句过去时，will 变 would。

u2.q: '放烟花' — 'set ____ fireworks'.
u2.explain: set off fireworks 燃放烟花。

u3.q: Excuse me, ____ you tell me the way to the museum?
u3.explain: Could you...? 是礼貌请求的常用句型。

u3.q: Do you know ____?
u3.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序。

u3.q: Turn right ____ the first crossing.
u3.explain: at the first crossing 在第一个十字路口。

u3.q: The bank is ____ the bookstore and the hotel.
u3.explain: between A and B 在两者之间。

u3.q: Which word means a place where you can watch films?
u3.explain: cinema 电影院。

u3.q: Could you tell me ____ to get to the train station?
u3.explain: how to do sth 疑问词加不定式作宾语。

u3.q: Go up the ____ to the second floor.
u3.explain: escalator 自动扶梯。

u3.q: It's about ten minutes' ____ from here.
u3.explain: ten minutes' walk 步行十分钟的路程。

u3.q: — Thank you very much. — ____
u3.explain: 对感谢的常用回答是 You're welcome。

u3.q: I'd like to know ____ we should meet tomorrow.
u3.explain: 问时间用 when 引导宾语从句。

u3.q: Which sentence is the most polite?
options: Could you please tell me where the restrooms are?
u3.explain: Could you please...? 最委婉礼貌。

u3.q: There is a ____ where you can buy medicine.
u3.explain: pharmacy 药店。

u3.q: Which words are places in a town?
u3.explain: honest 是形容词，不是地点名词。

u3.q: Which are correct object clauses?
options: Could you tell me what he does?
Do you know when the bus leaves?
Could you tell me where is he?
I wonder how I can get there.
u3.explain: C 项语序错误，应为 where he is。

u3.q: Which expressions are used to give directions?
u3.explain: D 项是问候语，不是指路。

u3.q: Which are polite expressions?
u3.explain: shut up 闭嘴，很不礼貌。

u3.q: 'Excuse me' is often used before asking a stranger for help.
u3.explain: 打扰陌生人前先说 Excuse me。

u3.q: 在宾语从句中不再使用 do/does/did 作助动词。
u3.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序，去掉助动词并还原时态。

u3.q: 'Restroom' is the American English word for a public toilet.
u3.explain: restroom 是美式英语中的洗手间。

u3.q: 'Go past the bank' means to walk beyond the bank.
u3.explain: go past 意为经过、走过。

u3.q: 'Turn left' and 'turn right' mean the same thing.
u3.explain: 一个是向左转，一个是向右转，方向相反。

u3.q: Using 'Could you please...' is more polite than giving an order.
u3.explain: 请求句型比祈使命令更礼貌。

u3.q: A department store is a place where you borrow books.
u3.explain: 百货商店是购物的地方，借书要去图书馆。

u3.q: The noun of 'direct' meaning 指路、方向 is ____ (often plural).
u3.explain: ask for directions 问路。

u3.q: '在拐角处' — 'at the ____'.
u3.explain: at the corner 在拐角处。

u3.q: Complete: Could you tell me where I can ____ (buy) some stamps?
u3.explain: can 后接动词原形。

u3.q: '过马路' — 'cross the ____'.
u3.explain: cross the street 过马路。

u3.q: '洗手间'的美式英语单词是 ____.
u3.explain: 美式 restroom，英式常用 toilet。

u3.q: '不用谢'的一种表达是 'You're ____'.
u3.explain: You're welcome. 不客气。

u3.q: '请求；要求'（动词，以 r 开头）is ____.
u3.explain: request 请求，也可作名词。

u4.q: There ____ a tall tree in front of my house, but it was cut down.
u4.explain: There used to be 表示过去存在某物。

u4.q: He didn't use to ____ so much.
u4.explain: didn't use to 后接动词原形。

u4.q: Let's go for a walk, ____?
u4.explain: Let's 开头的祈使句反意疑问句用 shall we。

u4.q: You have never been to Beijing, ____?
u4.explain: never 表否定，反意疑问句用肯定形式 have you。

u4.q: Which word means 'having no fear'?
u4.explain: brave 勇敢的。

u4.q: Paper is used ____ books and newspapers.
u4.explain: be used to do sth 被用来做某事。

u4.q: She used to be shy, but now she is quite ____.
u4.explain: 与 shy 相对的是 outgoing 外向的。

u4.q: I ____ to being alone now; it doesn't bother me.
u4.explain: be used to doing sth 习惯于做某事。

u4.q: Tom used to wear glasses, ____?
u4.explain: used to 的反意疑问句常用 didn't + 主语。

u4.q: Which sentence shows a change from the past to now?
options: He used to be fat, but now he is thin.
u4.explain: used to...but now... 表示前后变化。

u4.q: In the last few years, great changes have ____ place in my hometown.
u4.explain: take place 无被动语态，现在完成时为 have taken place。

u4.q: She ____ afraid of speaking in public, but now she enjoys it.
u4.explain: used to be 过去曾经是。

u4.q: Which are correct tag questions?
options: She is a teacher, isn't she?
He went home, didn't he go?
u4.explain: D 项多余，应为 didn't he?

u4.q: Which adjectives describe personality?
u4.explain: yellow 是颜色，不描述性格。

u4.q: Which sentences use 'be used to' correctly?
options: I am used to getting up early.
He is used to the weather here.
She is used to eat spicy food.
We are used to living in the city.
u4.explain: C 项应为 is used to eating。

u4.q: Which phrases mean 'to take care of'?
u4.explain: look up 是查阅，不表示照顾。

u4.q: 'There used to be' 用来说明某物过去存在。
u4.explain: There used to be 过去有。

u4.q: 反意疑问句中，如果主句是否定的，附加问句用肯定形式。
u4.explain: 前否后肯是基本规则。

u4.q: 'Be used to do sth' 是被动结构，意为'被用来做某事'。
u4.explain: be used to do 表被动用途。

u4.q: 'Used to' 后面可以直接接动词的 -ing 形式。
u4.explain: used to 后必须接动词原形。

u4.q: 'Deal with' means to handle a problem or situation.
u4.explain: deal with 处理、应对。

u4.q: 在 'Let's go, shall we?' 中，附加问句是 shall we。
u4.explain: Let's 开头用 shall we。

u4.q: People's hobbies and characters never change as they grow up.
u4.explain: 人的爱好和性格会随成长而改变。

u4.q: The noun form of 'humorous' is ____ (American spelling).
u4.explain: 美式拼写 humor，英式为 humour。

u4.q: '过去害怕黑暗' — 'used to be afraid of the ____'.
u4.explain: the dark 黑暗。

u4.q: Fill in the blank: He is used to ____ (live) in the country.
u4.explain: be used to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。
not...any more 不再。

u4.q: '与某人相处融洽' — 'get ____ well with sb'.
u4.explain: get along well with sb。

u4.q: The comparative form of 'outgoing' is 'more ____'.
u4.explain: 多音节形容词用 more 构成比较级。

u4.q: '为某事感到自豪' — 'take pride ____ sth'.
u4.explain: take pride in sth 等于 be proud of sth。

u5.q: The classroom ____ every day by the students.
u5.explain: 一般现在时被动语态 is + 过去分词。

u5.q: Wine is made ____ grapes.
u5.explain: 葡萄酒中看不出葡萄原样，用 be made from。

u5.q: These toys ____ by children all over the world.
u5.explain: 主语复数，被动用 are loved。

u5.q: The story ____ by Mo Yan.
u5.explain: 被动语态用 was + 过去分词 written。

u5.q: English ____ in many countries around the world.
u5.explain: 语言被人们说，用被动 is spoken。

u5.q: This kind of cloth feels ____.
u5.explain: feel 是系动词，后接形容词。

u5.q: The model plane was made ____ hand.
u5.explain: by hand 手工制作。

u5.q: Jingdezhen is famous for its ____.
u5.explain: 景德镇以瓷器 porcelain 闻名。

u5.q: Chopsticks are usually made ____ wood or bamboo.
u5.explain: 看得出原材料，用 be made of。

u5.q: Many trees ____ in our school every spring.
u5.explain: 树是被种，主语复数用 are planted。

u5.q: The passive form of 'They clean the room.' is ____.
u5.explain: 主动宾语变被动主语，谓语变 is cleaned。

u5.q: This bag ____ of leather and it looks very nice.
u5.explain: be made of 由……制成，需用被动形式。

u5.q: Which words can be materials?
u5.explain: quickly 是副词，不是材料。

u5.q: Which sentences are correct passive forms?
options: Rice is grown in the south.
The window was broken by Tom.
The book is write by him.
u5.explain: C 项应为 is written。

u5.q: Which are traditional Chinese products?
u5.explain: pizza 披萨来自意大利。

u5.q: Which sentences use 'by' to show the doer of the action?
options: The song was sung by Lily.
The picture was drawn by my sister.
The desk is made of wood.
The letter was written by Tom.
u5.explain: C 项 of wood 表示材料，不是动作执行者。

u5.q: 'Be made from' 用于原材料在成品中已看不出来的情况。
u5.explain: made from 强调原料已发生变化。

u5.q: 在被动语态中，如果动作执行者不明确，by 短语可以省略。
u5.explain: 执行者不明或不重要时省略 by 短语。

u5.q: 'They make cars in Japan.' 的被动形式是 'Cars are made in Japan.'
u5.explain: 宾语 cars 变为主语，谓语变被动。

u5.q: 只有及物动词（带宾语的动词）才能用于被动语态。
u5.explain: 不及物动词没有宾语，不能变被动。

u5.q: 'Be made of' 和 'be made from' 的用法完全相同。
u5.explain: 前者原料可辨认，后者不可辨认。

u5.q: Anhui Province is well known for its tea.
u5.explain: 安徽以茶叶闻名，如黄山毛峰。

u5.q: 一般现在时的被动语态结构是 'am/is/are + 过去分词'。
u5.explain: 这是现在时被动的基本构成。

u5.q: The past participle of 'write' is ____.
u5.explain: write-wrote-written。

u5.q: '棉花' in English is ____.
u5.explain: cotton 棉花、棉布。

u5.q: Change into passive: 'We use knives to cut things.' → 'Knives ____ (use) to cut things.'
u5.explain: 复数主语用 are used。

u5.q: '环境'（名词）in English is ____.
u5.explain: environment 环境。

u5.q: '以……闻名' — 'be famous ____ sth'.
u5.explain: be famous for 因……而出名。

u5.q: '手工制作的' — 'made by ____'.
u5.explain: made by hand 手工制作。

u5.q: The past participle of 'do' is ____.
u5.explain: do-did-done。

u6.q: Paper ____ by the Chinese about 2,000 years ago.
u6.explain: 过去时被动 was invented。

u6.q: The first plane ____ by the Wright brothers.
u6.explain: 过去发生的被动动作用 was made。

u6.q: According to the story, tea ____ by accident.
u6.explain: 茶是被发现的，用过去被动。

u6.q: Who ____ the telephone invented by?
u6.explain: 过去被动疑问句用 was + 主语 + 过去分词。

u6.q: A knife is used ____ cutting things.
u6.explain: be used for doing sth 被用于做某事。

u6.q: The ruler is used ____ straight lines.
u6.explain: be used to do sth 被用来做某事。

u6.q: Which invention helps people see at night?
u6.explain: 电灯泡照明。

u6.q: The compass was used to help sailors find their ____.
u6.explain: find one's way 辨明方向。

u6.q: 'Not only ... but also ...' means ____.
u6.explain: not only...but also... 不仅……而且……。

u6.q: These old houses ____ over 100 years ago.
u6.explain: 复数主语的过去被动用 were built。

u6.q: The Olympic Games ____ held in Beijing in 2008.
u6.explain: the Olympic Games 视为复数，用 were。

u6.q: Which one is NOT one of ancient China's four great inventions?
u6.explain: 四大发明是造纸术、印刷术、火药和指南针。

u6.q: Which sentences are in the past passive voice?
options: The house was built by my grandfather.
u6.explain: C 项是主动语态。

u6.q: Which are useful modern inventions?
u6.explain: 恐龙是史前动物，不是发明。

u6.q: Which phrases are correct?
u6.explain: 没有 be used of 的用法。

u6.q: Which words are related to inventing?
u6.explain: delicious 美味的，与发明无关。

u6.q: Papermaking is one of the four great inventions of ancient China.
u6.explain: 造纸术是四大发明之一。

u6.q: 过去时的被动语态用 'was/were + 过去分词' 构成。
u6.explain: 这是过去被动的基本结构。

u6.q: 'By accident' means on purpose.
u6.explain: by accident 意为偶然地，与 on purpose 故意相反。

u6.q: Tea was first drunk in China.
u6.explain: 中国是最早饮茶的国家。

u6.q: 当我们不知道动作的执行者时，常使用被动语态。
u6.explain: 被动语态可以避免提及不明的执行者。

u6.q: 'Be used by sb' 说明这个东西被谁使用。
u6.explain: by 后接使用者。

u6.q: The Wright brothers made the first practical airplane.
u6.explain: 莱特兄弟发明了第一架实用飞机。

u6.q: The past participle of 'take' is ____.
u6.explain: take-took-taken。

u6.q: '偶然地；碰巧' — 'by ____' (与 chance 有关).
u6.explain: by chance 偶然地。

u6.q: Fill in the blank: The bridge ____ (build) two years ago.
u6.explain: 过去被动 was built。

u6.q: The noun form of the verb 'invent' is ____.
u6.explain: invent 的名词形式为 invention。

u6.q: '把……分成' — 'divide sth ____ parts'.
u6.explain: divide sth into parts 把某物分成几部分。

u6.q: Fill in the blank: These photos ____ (take) by my father last week.
u6.explain: 复数主语过去被动 were taken。

u6.q: '电灯泡' in English is 'light ____'.
u6.explain: light bulb 电灯泡。

l1.q: Homework ____ be finished on time.
l1.explain: 情态动词后接 be + 过去分词构成被动。

l1.q: The rules must ____ by everyone.
l1.explain: must be followed 必须被遵守。

l1.q: Teenagers ____ allowed to stay up too late.
l1.explain: 熬夜太晚不应被允许，用 shouldn't be allowed。

l1.q: We should be ____ to think for ourselves.
l1.explain: should be + 过去分词构成情态被动。

l1.q: Sixteen-year-olds should be allowed to ____ their own clothes.
l1.explain: be allowed to 后接动词原形。

l1.q: 'Have a part-time job' means ____.
l1.explain: part-time job 兼职工作。

l1.q: My parents are strict ____ me about my study habits.
l1.explain: be strict with sb 对某人严格。

l1.q: It's important for teenagers ____ enough sleep.
l1.explain: It's + adj. + for sb + to do sth。

l1.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Students must not be allowed to smoke.
Students must not allowed to smoke.
Students must not be allow to smoke.
Students not must be allowed smoke.
l1.explain: 情态被动为 must not be + 过去分词。

l1.q: Old people should ____ well by their children.
l1.explain: 短语动词变被动要保留介词：be looked after。

l1.q: We should be allowed ____ our own decisions.
l1.explain: be allowed to do sth。

l1.q: 'Instead of' is usually followed by ____.
l1.explain: instead of 是介词短语，后接名词或动名词。

l1.q: Which are reasonable responsibilities for teenagers?
l1.explain: 彻夜不归不是应尽的责任。

l1.q: Which sentences are correct modal passives?
options: The work must be done today.
l1.explain: C 项漏了 be，应为 should be followed。

l1.q: Which words can mean 'to let someone do something'?
l1.explain: forbid 意为禁止，意思相反。

l1.q: Which school rules are reasonable?
options: Students should keep the classroom clean.
Students should not run in the hallways.
l1.explain: 禁止提问不合理。

l1.q: 'Should be allowed to do' 是含情态动词的被动语态。
l1.explain: 情态动词 + be + 过去分词。

l1.q: 'Allow sb to do sth' 是正确的主动结构。
l1.explain: allow 后接不定式作宾语补足语。

l1.q: 'Be strict with sb' 和 'be strict in sth' 都是正确搭配。
l1.explain: with 接人，in 接事。

l1.q: Teenagers should never be given any freedom at all.
l1.explain: 青少年应在合理范围内拥有一定自由。

l1.q: 'Get in the way of' means to stop something from happening.
l1.explain: get in the way of 妨碍、阻碍。

l1.q: 含情态动词的被动语态结构是'情态动词 + be + 过去分词'。
l1.explain: 这是本单元的核心结构。

l1.q: 'Sixteen-year-olds' 在句中可以作名词，意为'16 岁的孩子们'。
l1.explain: 带 -s 的复合名词表示某年龄段的人。

l1.q: The noun form of the verb 'decide' is ____.
l1.explain: decide 的名词形式为 decision。

l1.q: '足够的睡眠' — 'enough ____'.
l1.explain: enough sleep 充足睡眠。

l1.q: Fill in the blank: Teenagers should not ____ (allow) to drive.
l1.explain: 情态被动 should not be allowed。

l1.q: '兼职工作' — 'a part-____ job'.
l1.explain: part-time job 兼职工作。

l1.q: '专心于；集中精力于' — 'concentrate ____ sth'.
l1.explain: concentrate on 专注于。

l1.q: The opposite of the noun 'success' is ____.
l1.explain: success 成功，failure 失败。

l1.q: '实现梦想' — 'achieve one's ____'.
l1.explain: achieve one's dream 实现梦想。

l2.q: The man in black ____ be a thief, but I'm not sure.
l2.explain: 不确定的推测用 might。

l2.q: Whose jacket is this? It ____ be Mike's — it's much too small for him.
l2.explain: 太小了，不可能是他的，用 can't。

l2.q: There is nobody in the room. They ____ be out.
l2.explain: 有依据的肯定推测用 must。

l2.q: This handbag ____ Anna's; she lost hers yesterday.
l2.explain: 她昨天丢了包，因此这个很可能就是她的。

l2.q: 'Belong to' cannot normally be used in the ____ form.
l2.explain: belong to 是状态动词，一般不用进行时。

l2.q: Whose book is this? — It's ____.
l2.explain: 名词性物主代词 hers 可单独使用。

l2.q: A person who studies ancient objects and buildings is an ____.
l2.explain: archaeologist 考古学家。

l2.q: 'Run after' means ____.
l2.explain: run after sb 追赶某人。

l2.q: Something that you cannot explain is a ____.
l2.explain: mystery 神秘事物、谜。

l2.q: The teacher ____ be angry with us, but I hope not.
l2.explain: 不确定的可能性用 might。

l2.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: It is difficult for us to finish it.
It is difficult of us to finish it.
It is difficult for us finish it.
It difficult for us to finish.
l2.explain: It is + adj. + for sb + to do sth。

l2.q: The music next door is very loud. Our neighbours ____ be having a party.
l2.explain: 根据明显证据作肯定推测，用 must。

l2.q: Which modal verbs express possibility rather than certainty?
l2.explain: must 表示很有把握的肯定推测。

l2.q: Which are possessive pronouns that can stand alone?
l2.explain: my 是形容词性物主代词，后面必须接名词。

l2.q: Which sentences are correct?
l2.explain: 推测的否定不用 mustn't，要用 can't。

l2.q: Which words describe not being sure?
l2.explain: confident 自信、确信，意思相反。

l2.q: 'Must be' 表示说话人几乎可以肯定的推测。
l2.explain: must be 表把握很大的肯定推测。

l2.q: 'Belong to' 后面接宾格代词，如 him、her。
l2.explain: belong to 后接宾格或名词。

l2.q: 'Mine' 相当于 'my + 名词'。
l2.explain: 名词性物主代词等于形容词性物主代词加名词。

l2.q: Stonehenge might have been used as a kind of calendar.
l2.explain: 课文提到巨石阵可能被用作某种日历。

l2.q: 'Could be' 表示的把握比 'must be' 更大。
l2.explain: could be 把握更小，must be 把握最大。

l2.q: 'Happen to do sth' means to do something by chance.
l2.explain: happen to do 碰巧做某事。

l2.q: 'Run away' means to escape or leave quickly.
l2.explain: run away 逃跑。

l2.q: 表示推测'不可能'用 '____ be'（can 加 not 的缩写）。
l2.explain: 否定推测用 can't be。

l2.q: '发生'（不用于被动语态）的动词，以 h 开头，是 ____.
l2.explain: happen 发生，无被动语态。

l2.q: Fill in the blank: This pen must be ____ (he).
l2.explain: 此处用名词性物主代词 his。

l2.q: '追赶某人' — 'run ____ sb'.
l2.explain: run after sb 追赶某人。

l2.q: The noun form of the adjective 'mysterious' is ____.
l2.explain: mysterious 的名词形式是 mystery。

l2.q: '与……有关' — 'have something to ____ with'.
l2.explain: have something to do with 与……有关。

l2.q: '确定的；肯定的'（形容词，以 c 开头）is ____.
l2.explain: certain 确定的，be certain about 对……确信。

l3.q: This is the house ____ was built in 1950.
l3.explain: 先行词是物，关系代词用 which 或 that。

l3.q: The teacher ____ taught us English has moved away.
l3.explain: 先行词是人且作主语，用 who。

l3.q: I'll never forget the day ____ we first met.
l3.explain: 先行词是时间且在从句中作状语，用 when。

l3.q: The song ____ she sang last night was very moving.
l3.explain: 先行词是物作宾语，用 that/which。

l3.q: He is the man ____ car was stolen last week.
l3.explain: 表示所属关系用 whose。

l3.q: Everything ____ he said at the meeting is true.
l3.explain: 先行词是 everything 时只能用 that。

l3.q: I don't like music that is ____ loud.
l3.explain: too loud 太吵。

l3.q: 'Lyrics' means ____.
l3.explain: lyrics 歌词，常用复数。

l3.q: In which sentence can the relative pronoun be left out?
options: The book I read was great.
The book that is on the desk is mine.
The man who called you is here.
The girl who sings is my friend.
l3.explain: 关系代词作宾语时可以省略。

l3.q: I prefer movies ____ have happy endings.
l3.explain: 先行词 movies 是物且作主语，用 that/which。

l3.q: 'Stick to' means ____.
l3.explain: stick to 坚持、固守。

l3.q: Peking Opera is a kind of Chinese ____.
l3.explain: 京剧是中国传统艺术。

l3.q: Which relative pronouns can be omitted when they act as the object?
l3.explain: whose 表所属，不能省略。

l3.q: Which sentences are correct?
options: I like books that are about history.
She is a singer who writes her own songs.
This is the pen which I lost.
I like music who is quiet.
l3.explain: D 项先行词是物，不能用 who。

l3.q: Which are musical instruments?
l3.explain: lyrics 是歌词，不是乐器。

l3.q: Which words describe styles of music?
l3.explain: electricity 电，不是音乐风格。

l3.q: 'Whose' 在定语从句中表示所属关系。
l3.explain: whose 意为'……的'。

l3.q: 先行词被 the only、all、everything 修饰时，通常用 that 而不用 which。
l3.explain: 这是只用 that 的常见情况。

l3.q: 定语从句放在它所修饰的名词之前。
l3.explain: 定语从句放在被修饰名词之后。

l3.q: 'Erquan Yingyue' is a famous piece of erhu music by Abing.
l3.explain: 《二泉映月》是阿炳的二胡名曲。

l3.q: 关系代词 who 可以用来指代物。
l3.explain: who 只指人，指物用 which/that。

l3.q: 'Remind sb of sth' means to make someone think of something.
l3.explain: remind sb of sth 使某人想起某事。

l3.q: 'Prefer A to B' means to like A better than B.
l3.explain: prefer A to B 更喜欢 A。

l3.q: '歌词' in English is ____ (usually plural).
l3.explain: lyrics 常用复数形式。

l3.q: Fill in the blank: I like people ____ (who/which) are friendly.
l3.explain: 先行词 people 指人，用 who。

l3.q: '电子音乐' — '____ music' (以 e 开头).
l3.explain: electronic music 电子音乐。

l3.q: The noun form of the verb 'perform' is ____.
l3.explain: perform 的名词形式是 performance。

l3.q: '坚持做某事' — 'stick ____ doing sth'.
l3.explain: stick to doing sth，to 是介词。

l3.q: The noun form of the adjective 'sad' is ____.
l3.explain: sad 的名词形式是 sadness。

l3.q: Fill in the blank: This is the best film ____ (that/which) I have ever seen.
l3.explain: 先行词被最高级修饰时用 that。

l4.q: In China, you are supposed to ____ when you meet someone for the first time.
l4.explain: 中国初次见面通常握手。

l4.q: You are not supposed ____ loudly in the library.
In France, people often ____ each other on the cheek when they meet.
We are expected ____ our shoes before entering a Japanese home.
'Make a mistake' means ____.
In Colombia, people are usually quite ____ about time.
l4.explain: 课文提到哥伦比亚人对时间比较随意。

l4.q: 'After all' means ____.
It's ____ to point at people with your finger.
l4.explain: 用手指着别人是不礼貌的。

l4.q: You'd better ____ late for the appointment.
'Drop by' means ____.
In Japan, people usually ____ to show respect when greeting.
'Table manners' means ____.
Which behaviours are polite at a Western dinner table?
options: Keeping your elbows off the table
l4.explain: 吃饭时发出很大声响不礼貌。

l4.q: Which sentences are correct?
options: You are supposed to be on time.
She is supposed to arrive at six.
We are not supposed to smoke here.

l4.q: Which are ways of greeting people?
Which words are about customs and behaviour?
'Be supposed to do sth' 可以表示'应该做某事'。
In Japan, bowing is a common way to greet people.
l4.explain: 鞠躬是日本常见的问候方式。

l4.q: 在中国，把筷子直插在饭里是礼貌的做法。
l4.explain: 筷子插在饭中被视为不吉利、不礼貌。

l4.q: 'Be expected to do sth' 可以和 'be supposed to do sth' 意思相近。
l4.explain: 两者都表示被期望、应该。

l4.q: In Switzerland, arriving late for a meeting is considered quite normal.
l4.explain: 瑞士人非常守时，迟到被视为无礼。

l4.q: Customs and manners are exactly the same in every country.
l4.explain: 不同国家的风俗礼仪差异很大。

l4.q: In a traditional Japanese house, you are expected to take off your shoes.
The opposite of 'polite' formed with the prefix im- is ____.
Fill in the blank: You are supposed ____ (greet) people politely.
'习俗；风俗'（以 c 开头）in English is ____.
'鞠躬'（以 b 开头）in English is ____.
'对时间很随意' — 'be ____ about time'（以 r 开头）.
l4.explain: be relaxed about time 对时间不严格。

l4.q: '准时'的另一种说法是 'on ____'.
'指出' — 'point ____'.

l5.q: The bad news made her ____.
l5.explain: make sb do sth 不带 to。

l5.q: Bright colours can make a small room look ____.
l5.explain: look 后接形容词比较级 bigger。

l5.q: The teacher made the students ____ the text aloud.
l5.explain: make sb do sth。

l5.q: The boys were made ____ the classroom after school.
l5.explain: make 的被动语态要还原 to。

l5.q: Which word means 'extremely tired'?
l5.explain: exhausted 筋疲力尽的。

l5.q: She felt ____ when she heard the good news.
l5.explain: feel 是系动词，后接形容词。

l5.q: The soup tastes ____.
l5.explain: taste 系动词后接形容词。

l5.q: 'Let sb down' means ____.
l5.explain: let sb down 使某人失望。

l5.q: The old song ____ me of my childhood.
l5.explain: remind sb of sth 使某人想起某事。

l5.q: In 'be + adj. + enough to do sth', 'enough' is placed ____.
l5.explain: enough 修饰形容词时放在其后。

l5.q: Rainy days often make some people feel ____.
l5.explain: feel down 情绪低落。

l5.q: 'Have an influence on' means ____.
l5.explain: have an influence on 对……有影响。

l5.q: Which adjectives describe feelings?
l5.explain: wooden 木制的，不描述情绪。

l5.q: Which sentences are correct?
options: He made me to wait for an hour.
We were made to work hard.
l5.explain: C 项主动语态中 make 后不加 to。

l5.q: Which verbs are linking verbs followed by adjectives?
l5.explain: carry 是实义动词，不是系动词。

l5.q: Which colours are often said to make people feel calm?
l5.explain: 鲜红色通常让人兴奋而非平静。

l5.q: 在主动语态中，'make sb do sth' 不带 to。
l5.explain: make 后接不带 to 的不定式。

l5.q: 'Feel like doing sth' means to want to do something.
l5.explain: feel like doing 想要做某事。

l5.q: 系动词 look、sound 后面要接副词。
l5.explain: 系动词后接形容词作表语。

l5.q: Bright red can make people feel excited or even nervous.
l5.explain: 鲜艳的红色让人兴奋甚至紧张。

l5.q: 'Make sb + adj.' 表示使某人处于某种状态。
l5.explain: 形容词作宾语补足语。

l5.q: 'Cheer sb up' means to make someone feel happier.
l5.explain: cheer sb up 使某人振作、高兴起来。

l5.q: 在主动语态中，let 和 make 后都接不带 to 的不定式。
l5.explain: let/make sb do sth。

l5.q: '使某人振作起来' — 'cheer sb ____'.
l5.explain: cheer sb up。

l5.q: Fill in the blank: The film made me ____ (think) about life.
l5.explain: make sb do sth，用动词原形。

l5.q: The noun form of the adjective 'happy' is ____.
l5.explain: happy 的名词形式是 happiness。

l5.q: '紧张的；焦虑的'（以 n 开头）in English is ____.
l5.explain: nervous 紧张的。

l5.q: '对某人有影响' — 'have an influence ____ sb'.
l5.explain: have an influence on sb。

l5.q: Fill in the blank: We were made ____ (stay) at home that day.
l5.explain: 被动语态中要还原 to。

l5.q: '精力；能量'（以 e 开头）in English is ____.
l5.explain: energy 精力、能量。

l6.q: By the time I finished my homework, my parents ____ to bed.
l6.explain: 过去之前发生的动作用过去完成时。

l6.q: She said she ____ the book before.
l6.explain: 主句过去时，之前的动作用 had read。

l6.q: I ____ my keys at home, so I couldn't open the door.
l6.explain: 把钥匙落在家里发生在开不了门之前。

l6.q: By the end of last year, he ____ over 100 books.
l6.explain: by the end of + 过去时间，用过去完成时。

l6.q: 'Run out of' means ____.
l6.explain: run out of 用完、耗尽。

l6.q: The old table was covered ____ dust.
l6.explain: be covered with 被……覆盖。

l6.q: 'Show up' means ____.
l6.explain: show up 出现、露面。

l6.q: The plane ____ off before we got to the airport.
l6.explain: 起飞在到达之前，用过去完成时。

l6.q: Which time expression is often used with the past perfect tense?
l6.explain: by the time 常与过去完成时连用。

l6.q: 'Be filled with' has almost the same meaning as ____.
l6.explain: be filled with 等于 be full of 充满。

l6.q: I was very tired because I ____ all day.
l6.explain: 疲惫之前已经工作了一整天。

l6.q: In this unit, 'set off' can mean ____.
l6.explain: set off 出发、动身。

l6.q: Which sentences use the past perfect correctly?
options: He had finished his work before I came.
By 2010, she had moved to Beijing.
I had gone there at 8 o'clock yesterday morning.
They had left when we arrived.
l6.explain: C 项有明确过去时间点，应用一般过去时。

l6.q: Which are unexpected or unlucky events?
l6.explain: 认真计划旅行不是意外事件。

l6.q: Which phrases can mean 'to arrive'?
l6.explain: give up 意为放弃。

l6.q: Which words describe feelings after something goes wrong?
l6.explain: delighted 高兴的，不符合。

l6.q: 过去完成时表示'过去的过去'。
l6.explain: 指过去某时之前已完成的动作。

l6.q: 谈论过去时，'by the time' 从句后的主句常用过去完成时。
l6.explain: by the time + 过去时从句，主句用过去完成时。

l6.q: 'Oversleep' means to sleep longer than you planned.
l6.explain: oversleep 睡过头。

l6.q: 'Had + 过去分词' 适用于所有人称。
l6.explain: 过去完成时的 had 不随人称变化。

l6.q: 过去完成时可以脱离任何过去的时间参照单独使用。
l6.explain: 过去完成时必须以某个过去时间或动作为参照。

l6.q: 'Be about to do sth' means to be going to do it very soon.
l6.explain: be about to do 即将做某事。

l6.q: April Fool's Day is on the first of April.
l6.explain: 愚人节是 4 月 1 日。

l6.q: The past participle of 'begin' is ____.
l6.explain: begin-began-begun。

l6.q: Fill in the blank: By the time he arrived, the meeting ____ (end).
l6.explain: 会议在他到达之前已结束。

l6.q: '用完；耗尽' — 'run ____ of'.
l6.explain: run out of 用完。

l6.q: '意想不到的事' — 'the ____'（在 expect 前加否定前缀并变形）.
l6.explain: the unexpected 意外的事。

l6.q: The past participle of 'throw' is ____.
l6.explain: throw-threw-thrown。

l6.q: '即将做某事' — 'be about ____ do sth'.
